records.name: Sonic Kick
records.character_source: Piccolo / Dyspo / Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) customizable partner / Jiren customizable partner
records.skill_description: A two-hit tracking kick that flies through the opponent and then backtracks for a second attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a forward kick followed by a return/backtracking kick whether or not the first hit connects. The move is short-range, tracking, and can function as a reactive/counter-oriented Strike Super. Exact frame data and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric fields.
records.acquisition_notes: The Future Warrior can obtain Sonic Kick from the Skill Shop. It is also used by Piccolo and several customizable or cast characters.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Independent community documentation describes the move as a low-cost tracking utility/counter option. Detailed matchup and frame claims remain version-sensitive.
